applicable_when: The kernel is a tensor transpose: it reads from in_ptr0 with address y0 + 128*x2 + 4032000*y1. With XBLOCK=128, consecutive threads in the x-dimension access addresses separated by 128 float32 elements (512 bytes), making every load completely non-coalesced. All 128 threads in a warp issue 128 separate cache-line requests instead of 1. This saturates L2 at 96.79% and causes 43.8-cycle stall per warp (57.1% of all stalls). The fix is to iterate threads over the stride-1 channel dimension (y0) rather than the stride-128 spatial dimension (x2), so loads become coalesced. Adding @triton.autotune explores the best tile shape and num_warps for this GPU.
